Based on my search, I can provide you with information about Microsoft account login issues and how to resolve them.

## Microsoft Account Login Help

If you're experiencing issues with **account/microsoft/login**, here are the common problems and solutions:

### Common Login Issues

1. **Forgotten Password** - Use the [Microsoft Sign-in Helper](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accounts-billing/manage/i-can-t-sign-in-to-my-microsoft-account) to reset your password

2. **Error 400** - This usually means your sign-in request couldn't be processed due to:
   - Too many sign-in attempts in a row
   - Issues with your app, browser, device, or network
   - **Solutions**: Use a different sign-in method, update your app, switch devices, or change your network

3. **"We can't sign in to your account" / Temporary Profile Error** - Windows creates a temporary profile when your user profile can't load
   - **Solutions**: Restart in safe mode, temporarily disable antivirus, or create a new local administrator account

4. **Error 0x87DD0006** - Indicates network connectivity, permissions, or account issues
   - **Solutions**: Verify internet connection, clear cache/cookies, check credentials, update Windows, or temporarily disable antivirus/firewall

5. **"Oops, something went wrong"** - Usually caused by account synchronization conflicts
   - **Solution**: Go to Settings > Accounts > Your info > click Sign in to refresh your account connection

### Quick Troubleshooting Steps

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Clear browser cache and cookies |
| 2 | Try incognito/private browsing mode |
| 3 | Switch to a different network (Wi-Fi to mobile data or vice versa) |
| 4 | Try a different device |
| 5 | Wait 24-48 hours if you've made too many attempts |
| 6 | Update your Microsoft apps and Windows |
| 7 | Temporarily disable antivirus/firewall |

### Official Microsoft Login Page

To sign in to your Microsoft account, visit:
- **https://account.microsoft.com** or
- **https://login.microsoftonline.com**

### Need More Help?

- Use the [Microsoft Sign-in Helper tool](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accounts-billing/manage/i-can-t-sign-in-to-my-microsoft-account) for automated troubleshooting
- Visit [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com) for personalized assistance
- Check [Microsoft Service Status](https://status.office365.com) for any ongoing outages

---
